title: Potter County Sheriffs Made Arrests Tuesday For Assault, Non-Support & Theft of Property - NewsBreak
text:
By Tim Butler ,
13 hours ago Potter County Sheriffs arrested 52-year-old Deanna Andersen Tuesday night at 10:07 in the 7100 block of Wolflin for Aggravated Assault with a Deadly Weapon. Deputies arrested Angela Rena Clark, age 40 Tuesday at 6pm in the 200 block of Southeast 3rd for Possession of a Controlled Substance Penalty Group-1 between 200 grams and 400 grams and Unlawful Possession of a Firearm by a Felon. 40-year-old Kenneth William Collin was arrested Tuesday at 3pm in the 6000 block of Amarillo Blvd-West for Theft of Aluminum, Bronze, Brass or Copper greater than $20,000. Bond was set at $2,000 for 27-year-old Hunter Scott Flowers who was arrested by Potter County Tuesday at 8:19am in the 1100 block of North Mirror for Criminal Non-Support. Potter County arrested 34-year-old Kristi Sullivan Tuesday afternoon at 3:30 in the 900 block of South Polk for Theft of Property between $100 and $750. Read full article
